prerequisites.requirement: Query and cryptographically log the active exchange `/fapi/v1/leverageBracket` schedule (notional floor, notional cap, `maintMarginRatio`, `cum` maintenance amount, max allowed leverage) before any session startup; reject startup if bracket parameters are missing or stale.

Explicitly assert and lock `marginType=ISOLATED`, target integer leverage `L`, and `dualSidePosition=false` (One-Way mode) via signed account configuration endpoints before enabling signal admission; forbid cross-margin collateral bleed unless explicitly authorized.

All protective stop (`STOP_MARKET`/`STOP`) and partial take-profit (`TAKE_PROFIT`/`LIMIT`) exit orders must set `reduceOnly=true` and explicitly declare `workingType` (`CONTRACT_PRICE` vs `MARK_PRICE`) so that Last-triggered strategy stops and Mark-triggered exchange liquidations have unambiguous trigger telemetry.

Assign deterministic `newClientOrderId` keys per `(event_id, leg, revision)` and enforce a strict finite-state machine for the TP1 partial fill -> stop quantity amendment (`q -> q - q1`) and break-even price amendment (`stop -> eff_entry`) transition so in-flight cancel-replace races cannot over-close or flip net position.

Reconcile WebSocket `ORDER_TRADE_UPDATE` and `ACCOUNT_UPDATE` events against REST order status; keep exited notional and realized P&L locked until terminal fill ACK and verified wallet balance update, with hard kill-switch on any unexpected position or margin ratio breach.

Record top-of-book BBO/L2 depth at order submission/fill timestamps and capture exact exchange `FUNDING_FEE` income records (timestamp, symbol, income, asset, tradeId/info) at 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC to replace the retrospective 1m Mark close approximation.
